beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Schoology review now offers clearer filed-sample replacement with undo and task preview shortcuts.

Fixes:
• Fixed an error displaying the review badge when multiple Mr. D samples arrive for the same student and course.
• Schoology refresh now detects submitted work even when an old Missing grade remains, and missing-work indicators follow the selected learning period.
• Course Activity stays in place while reviewing submissions.
• Clicking To-do now closes the open tray without immediately reopening it.
• Converting browser work samples to PDF no longer flashes a terminal window.
• Corrected samples sent with the same filename now reach review instead of being discarded as duplicates.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
